title: Face Sculpt Silverfox #123 · 한국 실버폭스 40대 중 · 카리스마 있는 · 옆트임 최극한(4배) · 각진 턱 · 코랄 립 극한 · P25
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 40s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Korean woman — Korean fresh natural beauty light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, mid 40s, long silver-white hair in soft waves swept to one side, pushed to the absolute extreme: neon-bright saturated orange-red lacquer-glossy lips overlined fuller than natural, bold golden-peach eyeshadow, dramatic lashes, a glowing warm blush, odd-eyed with two clearly different lenses: her left eye has a bright turquoise coloured contact lens with round natural pupils, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, and her right eye has a hot-pink coloured contact lens with a thick dark outer ring and round natural pupils, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, the two eye colours both bright and clearly different from each other, a piercing direct stare, jaw set, lips firmly closed, a bold, commanding, fierce expression — a photograph of a real Korean woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her mouth is slightly open, her lips parted just enough to clearly show her teeth, with pointed, elongated, sharp canine fangs and a few tiny diamonds set on her front teeth (this overrides the lips pressed or closed in her expression). Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while the colours of her eyeshadow and liner follow her makeup): pure fantasy eyes, impossibly long but elegantly beautiful: the outer corners of both eyes sweep far beyond her temples to the very side of her head above her ears, and the inner corners are fully opened with the small pink inner corner visible, so each eye opening is about four times its natural length, an extremely long, thin, razor-sharp almond shape like a long blade spanning the whole width of her face, showing a huge amount of iris and white; a razor-sharp eyeliner in the colour of her makeup follows the entire shape and ends in a very long, fine point at the side of her head; the eyes are in very large coloured big-iris contact lenses with a glossy shine and a big iris, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights; her nose: a high, straight, refined, surgically sculpted nose: a tall, slim, straight bridge, a narrow, pointed, projecting tip and clearly narrow nostril wings with slim, neat nostrils; her jawline and chin: a strong, angular, square jawline: a wide, clearly defined, sharp-cornered jaw angle just below each ear, a broad flat chin with a slight cleft, hollow sculpted cheeks and very high, razor-sharp cheekbones. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about seventeen in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; two small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; two small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are punk in style: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are safety-pin shaped bars, sharp cone-spike studs and chunky chain-link rings. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of these two iron rings, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly nine separate massive weights, each of a different shape, all of them tarnished dark silver with a rough, hammered, unpolished matte surface, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal: on the left ear a ship's anchor on a shortest chain, a square-sided cowbell on a shortest chain, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a short chain, a barrel-shaped weight on a medium chain, a teardrop-shaped sinker on a medium chain, a miniature anvil on a long chain, a hammer head on a longer chain, a pyramid-shaped lump on a longer chain, a cube-shaped block on a longest chain; on the right ear a hammer head on a shortest chain, a pyramid-shaped lump on a shortest chain, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a short chain, a teardrop-shaped sinker on a medium chain, a round bell on a medium chain, a ship's anchor on a long chain, a cube-shaped block on a longer chain, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a longer chain, a miniature anvil on a longest chain. On each ear the two iron rings each carry their own column of weights, the two columns holding 5 and 4 weights, hanging side by side on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because the load is shared between two openings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real blackened steel and chrome silver, spiked and studded, with no gemstones, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished silver, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
